LESSON: DRAWING MAKING OBSERVATION A) USE APPROPRIATE TOOLS TO

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PICTURE
Topic 1.1: Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. draw simple representation from observation
2. appreciate each other’s, drawing from observation drawings in pairs and groups draw pictures using ICT devices Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. draw simple representation from observation
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to draw simple representation from observation. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate each other’s, drawing from observation drawings in pairs and groups draw pictures using ICT devices Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate each other’s, drawing from observation drawings in pairs and groups draw pictures using ICT devices Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to.
2. Explain Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to.
4. Show that you can: draw simple representation from observation
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Drawing MAKING observation a) use appropriate tools to important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. draw simple representation from observation
2. appreciate each other’s, drawing from observation drawings in pairs and groups draw pictures using ICT devices Core-Competence: Creativity and imagination

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
